ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (black) dominate approximately 92% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity pixels (white) comprising approximately 8% in the form of localized markings and edge textures.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) field across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast (white) linear streaks are clustered in the mid-left and lower-central regions. Two distinct, high-contrast annular (ring-shaped) pixel patterns are located in the upper-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The boundary displays low-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the inner 80% of the trailing edge. The distal 10% of each lobe exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular pixel protrusions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rough-textured, high-intensity masses at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; multiple depigmented linear rake marks and circular ring-scars across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A pair of interlocking high-contrast circular rings located on the upper surface of the right lobe.
